roadmap_payload.problem: A released CDC package can pass exact-tree and package validation while a retained package test still depends on a canonical repository fixture outside the package.
roadmap_payload.fix: Make retained package regressions self-contained and add a clean vendored-layout full-suite gate with no canonical repo-root fixtures available.
roadmap_payload.invariant: Every fixture required by retained package tests is inside the released package tree, and the full package suite passes from a real vendored consumer layout without repository-external canonical files.
